**Surfaced 2026-05-17 by user-tier POLYBIUS during end-of-session hygiene audit + stoa--ize backlog-sweep.** Second canonification batch covering 4 small discipline-encoding candidates. Bundled because they share theme (small substrate-canon hygiene tightenings) + can ship together with low risk. Mirrors the Arc 32 / stoa--ewn pattern.

## The four candidates

### C1 — User-tier-to-main commit discipline (folds in stoa--k36)

**Source:** stoa--k36 (P3).

**The gap:** the-stoa CLAUDE.md states "Forward work happens on a feature branch, not on main." But user-tier POLYBIUS has been committing housekeeping directly to local main throughout substrate sessions — directive+activation-paste tracking commits, .gitignore narrowing, registry adds, retro doc, substrate-template frontmatter backfill, self-apply cleanups, etc. (10+ direct-to-main commits per session). The CLAUDE.md rule reads as universal; actual practice has an implicit exception for housekeeping; no canon distinguishes what may commit directly vs what needs an arc.

**Fix shape (DAEDALUS picks):**
- **Option A — explicit user-tier housekeeping discipline section** in MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md (or operating-disciplines.md cross-ref) naming what user-tier may commit directly to main (directive+paste tracking, substrate-tool self-apply, orphan cleanup, retro docs, bw via orphan branch) vs what needs an arc (substrate canon edits, tooling source changes, anything PLINY gauntlet would normally cover)
- **Option B — strict (user-tier never commits to main; everything goes through an arc)** — cleaner CLAUDE.md interpretation; probably too restrictive
- **Option C — composite (encode discipline in canon per Option A + update CLAUDE.md to acknowledge the exception)**

User-tier POLYBIUS recommends Option C.

### C2 — HUMAN_paste-*.md archival convention (folds in stoa--f37)

**Source:** stoa--f37 (P4).

**The gap:** workspace root accumulates HUMAN_paste-*.md files from every arc dispatch (14+ tracked files from arcs 21-33; new ones every dispatch). No archival or cleanup convention.

**Fix shape (DAEDALUS picks):**
- **Option α — archive on arc close:** PLINY moves HUMAN_paste-{polybius,pliny}-arc-N-instruction.md from workspace root to substrate/arcs/<N>/pastes/ subdirectory at arc close
- **Option β — delete on arc close:** PLINY deletes the paste files at arc close; historical pastes recoverable via git history
- **Option γ — leave + accept:** document the accumulation as feature not bug

User-tier POLYBIUS recommends Option α (parallel to existing substrate/arcs/arc-N-build-directive.md archival pattern).

### C3 — Template-title cosmetic fix (folds in stoa--3qi)

**Source:** stoa--3qi (P? — filed by Arc 32 PLINY as CATO F1).

**The gap:** substrate/templates/paste-instruction-template.md title still says "MAJOR_PLINY activation" but Arc 32 C2 made the cron-hygiene clause dual PLINY+POLYBIUS. Title is out-of-date with content.

**Fix shape:** update title to reflect dual-targeting (e.g., "MAJOR_PLINY + MAJOR_POLYBIUS activation" or "PLINY-targeted and POLYBIUS-targeted activation"). Small cosmetic edit.

### C4 — HITL-paused queue sweep discipline (NEW; surfaced 2026-05-17 via stoa--jru rediscovery)

**Surfaced 2026-05-17 by user-tier POLYBIUS during stoa--ize investigation.**

**Empirical anchor:** stoa--jru (Arc 22 coordination hygiene) sat HITL-paused-pre-dispatch from 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-17 — ~2 weeks — without surfacing to PRINCIPAL. The HITL gate "wait for PRINCIPAL approval before dispatch" worked correctly (didn't auto-dispatch), but no mechanism surfaced "you have an open HITL-paused epic waiting on you" to PRINCIPAL across the 2-week gap. Multiple POLYBIUS sessions in that window defaulted to working on PRINCIPAL's current direction without sweeping the open-queue for HITL-paused items.

**The gap:** no substrate canon for **"POLYBIUS periodically sweeps open HITL-paused tickets and surfaces them to PRINCIPAL."** Sessions default to working on current stated direction; nobody runs `bw list --open --filter-for-hitl-paused` and asks "is this one ready to dispatch yet?" The morning handoff doc would have helped if it had a "HITL-paused queue" section, but it didn't.

**Fix shape (DAEDALUS picks):**
- **Option α — POLYBIUS activation checklist addition** in MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §9 (after `bw prime` step): sweep open epics for HITL-paused indicators ("TBD by user-tier POLYBIUS once PRINCIPAL approves", "blocked-on-PRINCIPAL", "awaiting PRINCIPAL adjudication", etc.); surface findings to PRINCIPAL in the session's first turn.
- **Option β — handoff-doc template addition** in substrate/templates/handoff-doc-template.md: new section "HITL-paused queue" that the multi-artifact handoff index doc explicitly enumerates open paused-pre-dispatch tickets.
- **Option γ — both (canon discipline at POLYBIUS activation + handoff-doc-template carries the section)** — defense in depth.

User-tier POLYBIUS recommends Option γ.

## Out of scope (HARD LOCKED)

- **stoa--32b.2 (mechanical-script / agent-inspection split)** — separate forthcoming arc; would be the structural ENFORCEMENT of these prose disciplines. CLOSED today via Arc 33.
- **stoa--ize Arc 22 disposition (stoa--jru)** — separate forthcoming arc (Arc 36 per current sequencing).
- **stoa--vz9 universal disciplines promotion** — separate forthcoming arc (Arc 37 post-audit).
- **stoa--kjo per-agent git identity** — separate forthcoming arc (Arc 35).
- **u--7yg.16 envelope tool-set gaps** — separate audit; would file as ticket if audit surfaces real gaps; not folded into this batch.
- **u--7yg.21 .claude/ gitignored** — operational truth; not actionable.
- **ariadne--1of agent-team-on-beadwork** — product epic; separate prioritization.
- **s4--bbz** — paused per PRINCIPAL until stoa work complete.

If you find yourself reaching for any of the above, STOP and surface as substance-disagreement comment.

## Acceptance (probes — VERA scopes precisely)

- C1: MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md (or operating-disciplines.md per DAEDALUS pick) has new section naming what user-tier may direct-commit to main. CLAUDE.md updated if Option C picked.
- C2: archival convention documented at MAJOR_PLINY.md §X or substrate/arcs/ README; PLINY arc-close discipline encoded.
- C3: substrate/templates/paste-instruction-template.md title reflects dual PLINY+POLYBIUS targeting.
- C4: POLYBIUS activation checklist + handoff-doc-template have HITL-paused-queue-sweep section/step per DAEDALUS pick.
- Cite-comments resolve.
- Authorship: zero author-like fields added/modified.

## §15 N=1 honesty

- C1: empirically anchored by today's session direct-commits (N=multi)
- C2: empirically anchored by 14+ accumulated paste files
- C3: empirically anchored by CATO F1 finding
- C4: empirically anchored by 2-week stoa--jru paused-without-surfacing pattern

PRINCIPAL declared C1/C4 disciplines today via the stoa--ize sweep + Arc 22 rediscovery conversation. Substrate canon enters off-gate. Future POLYBIUS sessions either successfully apply these disciplines (further evidence) or surface fresh failure modes (revision triggers).

## Cross-refs

- stoa--k36 (folded as C1; source ticket; will close-cross-ref on Arc 34 ship)
- stoa--f37 (folded as C2; source ticket; will close-cross-ref on Arc 34 ship)
- stoa--3qi (folded as C3; source ticket; will close-cross-ref on Arc 34 ship)
- stoa--ize (the sweep that surfaced C4; will close on Arc 34 ship with cross-ref)
- stoa--ewn (Arc 32 canonification-batch-1 precedent for this bundling shape)
- stoa--jru (the empirical anchor for C4; will be re-opened in Arc 35 — refresh + dispatch — per PRINCIPAL approval)
